Name: JP's LED Lamps - Customizable Lamps
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]LED Lamps[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]I'll use these lamps to banish the darkness from every corner until there's nothing left, and the monster will disappear![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]This mod adds two new lamps that you can interact with; [color=#00ffff][b]a menu with several options will appear, and you can customize each lamp individually[/b][/color]. You can walk on the Inground Lamps. [/size][/font]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Georgia][b][u]MOBILE:[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][size=4]In the mobile version, the menu only appears if you aren't holding any tools. Tap the lamp in question with empty hands or any object that isn't a tool to open the menu. [/size]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d13ZrB43/Lamp1.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Turn the lights on and off with the push of a button![/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Increase or decrease the light's range. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Adjust the brightness by increasing or decreasing the light output. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]You can walk right over the inground lamps![/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6v0nRDX/Lamp1-1.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]﻿[size=3]Switch between 44 available colors at any time![/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]The higher the intensity level, the better the colors will look. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/85YJH607/Lamp1-2.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿Set a proximity sensor radius; when you move away from the lamp, it will turn off automatically. Move closer again to turn it back on![/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]It is affected by the schedule. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gJ7XDZT6/Lamp1-3.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿You can set a schedule for when the lamp turns on; outside of those hours, it will not turn on in any other way. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]This can be combined with the proximity sensor option. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9fJqDSPv/Cm-PPP.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Switch between different lighting modes. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Z57WZQ8k/Cm-PPP1.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]You can create your own skins for the lamps! Check the Mod's Skins folder. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]You're free to do whatever you want; you can distribute them if you'd like![/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, there are lots of options to try and lots of combinations to experiment with![/size][/color][/i][/b]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
